Subject: Sample project kit: inference-service task — submission & review scheduling

Hi Samantha,

Thanks again for interviewing with us last week — we enjoyed the conversation. As discussed, attached is a short take-home project that helps us see how you reason about serving and performance tradeoffs for an inference endpoint. The packet is intentionally small (2–3 hours).

What’s included:
- 1 page prompt (20270414-inference-task-prompt.pdf) — implement or pseudocode a minimal inference handler and describe latency/cost tradeoffs.
- A short rubric (review-rubric.md) describing what reviewers should look for.

Deadline: Friday, Apr 16 at 11:59pm PT. Please reply to this thread with your submission (PDF or link to a GitHub gist). If you need more time, reply with the requested extension and a brief note on why.

Next steps on our side: I’m looping in Priyom (hiring panel lead) and Marissa (scheduler) to coordinate reviewers and debrief. Priyom — would you and Laura be available to review on Monday (Apr 19)? We’ll aim for a 30-minute sync for debrief if both review.

Let me know if anything is unclear. Good luck!

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Senior Engineering Manager, Inference
Redwood Inference

Attachment: 20270414-inference-task-prompt.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: review-rubric.md (text/markdown)

Thanks Samantha — submission received and saved to our candidate folder. Priyom/Laura — please review with the attached rubric; I left brief inline notes in the Drive doc for clarity. Marissa — please keep the 10:30–11:00 PT debrief slot unless either reviewer objects.

Proposed debrief agenda (30m):
- 5m: quick candidate summary & highlights
- 15m: rubric + technical observations (Priyom/Laura)
- 5m: strengths/gaps and hire/no-hire recommendation
- 5m: next steps (recruiter outreach / onsite scheduling)

If reviewers can post quick comments in the Drive doc before the call it will speed things up. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbC-internal-hiring-sample-packets

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the debrief Monday.

Nikhil Sharma
Senior Engineering Manager, Inference
Redwood Inference
